stock-potency-physical-and-concentration.scope: Native add/remove/re-add of source 317 stats 1140 +11, 1144 +11 and 1090 +10. stock-selective-phage-upgrade-consumers.scope: A complete stock view-zero 80 b9 3a 04 activation spends 20 IS, starts 30 s own reuse and adds 172 +2, 183 +2 and 342 +4. stats.source: Shipped 317 scales loaded melee and ballistic resistance bonuses by 0.24 and concentration bonus by 0.2. Stored float precision produces +11/+11/+10 at rank 50.
